_about: 게임식 겹치기(ai_design.py)용 재료 (2026-11-04) — 상용 게임 효과음처럼 '바로 터지는 타격 + 저음 무게 + 장식'을 따로 만들어 겹친다. ai_gen.py --spec ai_layers.json 으로 만듦 (sec는 정수 초)

L_hit.desc: 짧은 타격 (몸통 소리 앞에 붙여 바로 터지게)
L_hit.prompt: TrackType: SFX. A very short sharp punchy impact transient, designed video game hit, tight attack, dry, no tail.

L_metal.prompt: TrackType: SFX. A short sharp metallic clang hit, designed fighting game sword impact, tight and bright, dry.

L_click.prompt: TrackType: SFX. A short crisp digital click transient, punchy futuristic game interface sound, dry.

L_sub.prompt: TrackType: SFX. A deep cinematic sub bass boom impact, short and powerful, designed trailer hit with a fast low thump.

L_whoosh.prompt: TrackType: SFX. A fast short air whoosh swish, designed game attack swipe, close and punchy.

L_ice.prompt: TrackType: SFX. Sparkling ice crystal shimmer and tinkles, magical frost sweetener, bright and glassy.

L_holy.prompt: TrackType: SFX. A bright holy magic chime shimmer with a soft angelic choir swell, sparkling spell sweetener.

L_dark.prompt: TrackType: SFX. A dark magic energy whoosh with a distorted low rumble, designed evil game spell.

L_water.prompt: TrackType: SFX. A short punchy water splash impact, designed game water hit, wet and close.

L_zap.prompt: TrackType: SFX. A short sonic pulse zap with a resonant electric ring, designed sci-fi game hit.

L_debris.prompt: TrackType: SFX. Rock and concrete debris crumbling and scattering after a heavy explosion.
